description: This file defines the TelemetryImplementation class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It declares the class's interface, including nested classes for notifications, methods for telemetry and configuration, and internal state management. It also includes external dependencies and interface implementations related to telemetry, power management, and user settings.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry and configuration interfaces, managing power and user settings notifications, and dispatching telemetry events.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation::PowerManagerNotification
classes.description: Notification class for power mode changes, implementing IPowerManager::IModeChangedNotification.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation::UserSettingsNotification
classes.description: Notification class for user privacy mode changes, implementing IUserSettings::INotification (conditional on HAS_RBUS).

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation::Job
classes.description: Dispatch job class for handling telemetry events asynchronously.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the TelemetryImplementation instance.

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with name and value.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: notifyT2PrivacyMode
methods.description: Notifies about privacy mode changes (conditional on HAS_RBUS).

methods.name: onReportUploadStatus
methods.description: Handles report upload status updates (conditional on HAS_RBUS).

methods.name: getPrivacyMode
methods.description: Retrieves current privacy mode (conditional on HAS_RBUS).

methods.name: setRFCReportProfiles
methods.description: Sets report profiles via RFC (conditional on HAS_RBUS).

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a specific event with parameters.
